excerpt: Hey HN, We're Lambda School ( https://lambdaschool.com/computer-science ). We train people to become software engineers, and we charge nothing until a student gets a software job that pays more than $50k/yr. At that point we take 17% of income for two years (capped at a maximum of $30k total).
